derived_from.description: OncoKB curators' human-gene reference workbook, New_Framework tab (738 genes) exported to CSV; read as untrusted data by scripts/derive_curated_lists.py
derived_from.rule: cna: every gene whose 'Relevant alteration type(s)' contains 'Copy Number Alteration'. mutation: every gene whose 'Relevant alteration type(s)' contains 'Point Mutation' and whose upper-cased symbol is not in bailey2018_drivers.tsv. 'OG or TSG' copied verbatim; role = OG (Oncogene), TSG (TSG), OG/TSG (OG/TSG), otherwise unknown (blank, Neither, Insufficient Evidence). source_record is the logical CSV record number, header = 1.

licence: Internal OncoKB curation (Memorial Sloan Kettering), no public data licence. Only gene symbols, the curators' one-word OG/TSG label and a record number are copied; no evidence text, PMIDs, drugs or cancer types. Replace with an OncoKB API export before any external redistribution of the list itself.
